parameters.description: Cloud base height above model terrain for the reviewed ORIG cycle of 2026-11-02 12 UTC at 0, 6 and 48 h. The lowest qualifying model level sets the base. Columns without a qualifying level are missing. A single qualifying level gives the same base and top before packing.
parameters.description_cn: 2026-11-02 12 UTC 起报的 ORIG 0／6／48h，云底取最低合格模式层距模式地面的高度。无合格层时缺测。仅一层合格时，打包前云底与云顶相同。

parameters.description: Cloud top height above model terrain for the reviewed ORIG cycle of 2026-11-02 12 UTC at 0, 6 and 48 h. The highest qualifying model level sets the top. Columns without a qualifying level are missing. A single qualifying level gives the same base and top before packing.
parameters.description_cn: 2026-11-02 12 UTC 起报的 ORIG 0／6／48h，云顶取最高合格模式层距模式地面的高度。无合格层时缺测。仅一层合格时，打包前云底与云顶相同。

parameters.description: Height of maximum radar reflectivity. In the reviewed ORIG cycle of 2026-11-02 12 UTC, forecast fields at 6 and 48 h give the absolute model geopotential height of the strongest echo over the preceding hour. Echoes can reach the 30,000 m model top. The 0 h field is initialized to zero.
parameters.description_cn: 最大雷达回波高度。2026-11-02 12 UTC 起报的 ORIG +6／+48h 给出前一小时最强回波所在模式层的绝对位势高度，回波可达 30,000 m 模式顶。0h 为初始化零场。

parameters.description: Updraft helicity maximum. For the reviewed ORIG cycle of 2026-11-02 12 UTC, the 6 and 48 h values accumulate over the preceding output hour. The 0 h field is initialized to zero. Integration uses the 2000–5000 m terrain-following reference coordinate. The GRIB fixed surfaces and statistical interval preserve the producer's encoded selectors.
parameters.description_cn: 上升气流螺旋度最大值。2026-11-02 12 UTC 起报的 ORIG +6／+48h 在各自输出前一小时内取最大值，0h 为初始化零场。积分使用 2000–5000 m 地形跟随参考坐标。GRIB 固定面与统计窗保留生产端编码。
